title: Outcast e Nagge kaŋŋe
intro: Limre siftinaande e nder Quraan ardii jamaanu mawngu e nder majjere e sahaa nde annabi tedduɗo alaa. Huunde peewniraande kaŋŋe nanngi ɓerɗe leñol fof — kono daartol oo neɗɗo ina joofna e solitude e kuddi haawniindi. Hol ooɗoo ƴaañoowo potɗo wonde?
clues: Mi ummiima e sahaa mo annabi mawɗo umminoo ngam heɓde ardorde Alla.
Mi majjinii yimɓe heewɓe e huunde nde mbaɗmi e juuɗe am.
Tagɗo kaŋŋe mo peewnu-mi oo wayi ko no ina jogii nguurndam, ina yaltina daande ɓuuɓnde rewooɓe ɗum ɓee.
Miɗo wiya mi yi’i ko woɗɓe mbaawaa faamde — ƴeewndo e nder ko yi’aaka.
Mi ƴetti huunde e laabi nulaaɗo diine oo, mi werlii ɗum e njamndi mboɗeeri.
Mi ñaawaama ƴaañde miin tan, e kuddi keeriindi ndi hay gooto waawaa meemde ɓalndu am, miin mi meeɗaa meemde ɓalndu maɓɓe.

outcome.answer: Egguɓe, haɗaaɓe meemde walla meemde woɗɓe

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
